title: Ransomware Attack on EHR System
description: Ransomware encryption of electronic health record database causing extended patient care disruption and potential data loss
remediation_plan: Deploy EDR with anti-ransomware module; implement immutable backup strategy; conduct quarterly recovery drills

title: Phishing Campaign Targeting Clinical Staff
description: Spear-phishing emails impersonating internal departments to harvest credentials of clinical and administrative staff
remediation_plan: Mandatory quarterly phishing simulations; deploy DMARC/DKIM/SPF; implement URL sandboxing on email gateway

title: Third-Party Vendor Data Breach
description: Compromise of patient data through third-party billing vendor with inadequate security controls
remediation_plan: Enforce BAA security addendum; require SOC 2 Type II from all vendors; implement API gateway with DLP

title: Insider Threat - Unauthorized Data Access
description: Privileged users accessing patient records outside their authorized scope for personal gain or malice
remediation_plan: Implement UEBA for anomalous access detection; enforce least privilege with quarterly access reviews; deploy break-the-glass alerting

title: Cloud Storage Misconfiguration
description: Misconfigured S3 buckets or Azure Blob containers exposing protected health information to the public internet
remediation_plan: Enable AWS Config rules for public access detection; deploy CSPM tooling; enforce encryption-at-rest via SCP

title: Unpatched Critical Vulnerabilities
description: Known critical CVEs remaining unpatched beyond SLA on internet-facing systems including patient portal and telehealth platforms
remediation_plan: Automate patch deployment pipeline; reduce critical patch SLA to 72 hours; implement virtual patching via WAF

title: PHI Data Breach via Application Vulnerability
description: SQL injection or API abuse leading to exfiltration of protected health information from clinical applications
remediation_plan: Implement parameterized queries across all apps; deploy WAF with OWASP ruleset; conduct annual penetration testing

title: DDoS Attack on Patient Portal
description: Distributed denial of service attack rendering patient-facing services unavailable during peak usage periods
remediation_plan: Procure DDoS mitigation service; implement rate limiting and geo-blocking; establish incident response playbook

title: Software Supply Chain Attack
description: Compromised dependency or build pipeline injecting malicious code into internally developed healthcare applications
remediation_plan: Implement software composition analysis in CI pipeline; enforce signed commits; deploy dependency lockfiles and integrity verification

title: Credential Stuffing on Provider Portal
description: Automated credential stuffing attacks using breached credential databases against physician and staff login portals
remediation_plan: Enforce MFA on all provider accounts; deploy credential breach monitoring; implement progressive account lockout

title: HIPAA Compliance Gap - Audit Logging
description: Insufficient audit logging and monitoring to meet HIPAA requirements for access tracking and breach detection
remediation_plan: Expand SIEM log sources to cover all PHI-touching systems; implement 6-year log retention; automate compliance dashboards

title: Business Continuity - Data Center Failure
description: Single data center hosting critical clinical systems with no geographic redundancy for disaster recovery
remediation_plan: Establish secondary DR site with 4-hour RTO; implement active-passive replication for tier-1 systems; conduct biannual DR tests

title: Physical Security - Server Room Access
description: Inadequate physical access controls to server rooms allowing unauthorized entry and potential hardware tampering
remediation_plan: Install biometric access readers; deploy CCTV with 90-day retention; implement visitor escort policy for all server areas

title: API Security - Broken Authentication
description: Healthcare APIs lacking proper authentication and rate limiting exposing FHIR endpoints to unauthorized data access
remediation_plan: Implement OAuth 2.0 with SMART on FHIR scopes; deploy API gateway with rate limiting; add request signing for inter-system calls

title: Legacy System - End-of-Life OS
description: Critical laboratory information system running on Windows Server 2012 R2 with no vendor security patches available
remediation_plan: Isolate system in dedicated VLAN; deploy compensating controls via host IDS; accelerate LIS migration project to Q3 target

title: SOX Non-Compliance - Financial Reporting
description: Lack of segregation of duties in financial reporting systems creating risk of undetected fraudulent transactions
remediation_plan: Implement role-based access with SoD enforcement; deploy continuous monitoring for SoD violations; automate control testing

title: Wireless Network Exploitation
description: Rogue access points and weak wireless security allowing unauthorized network access in clinical areas
remediation_plan: Deploy wireless IDS/IPS; enforce WPA3-Enterprise; implement 802.1X with certificate-based authentication; conduct quarterly rogue AP scans

title: Medical Device Security - IoMT
description: Unmanaged and unpatched internet-connected medical devices creating lateral movement pathways into clinical networks
remediation_plan: Inventory all connected medical devices; segment IoMT on dedicated VLAN; deploy passive network monitoring for anomaly detection

title: Data Loss Prevention Gap
description: Absence of DLP controls allowing sensitive data exfiltration via email attachments and cloud storage uploads
remediation_plan: Deploy endpoint DLP agents; implement email content inspection rules for PHI patterns; block unauthorized cloud storage services

title: Privileged Access Misuse - Admin Accounts
description: Shared administrative accounts without individual accountability on critical infrastructure systems
remediation_plan: Deploy privileged access management platform; eliminate shared accounts; implement session recording for all admin access; enforce JIT privilege elevation
